description: This Java class 'Metrics' manages and tracks various metrics related to the MockServer, including counters for requests, actions, WebSocket events, and other operational data. It uses Prometheus Gauge objects for metric collection and provides methods to set, increment, decrement, and clear metrics.

classes.name: Metrics
classes.description: A class for collecting and managing various operational metrics for MockServer, including counters for requests, actions, WebSocket events, and error counts.

classes.name: Metrics.Name
classes.description: An enum defining different metric names and their descriptions used within the Metrics class.

methods.name: Metrics
methods.description: Constructor that initializes metrics based on configuration and registers build info collector if metrics are enabled.

methods.name: getOrCreate
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a Gauge metric associated with a given Name, with synchronized access to ensure thread safety.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Resets a specific metric identified by Name to zero.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a specific metric to a given integer value.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the current value of a specific metric.

methods.name: increment
methods.description: Increments a specific metric by one.

methods.name: increment
methods.description: Increments a metric corresponding to an Action.Type by one.

methods.name: decrement
methods.description: Decrements a specific metric by one.

methods.name: decrement
methods.description: Decrements a metric corresponding to an Action.Type by one.

methods.name: clearRequestAndExpectationMetrics
methods.description: Clears metrics related to requests and expectations.
